# mimecast_dns_authentication_outbound_definitions (Data Source)

Read all DNS authentication outbound definitions with cursor pagination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_dns_authentication_outbound_definitions" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `dns_address` (String) DNS record address.
- `domain` (String) Signing domain.
- `id` (String) Definition ID.
- `key_length` (Number) DKIM key length.
- `public_key` (String) Public DKIM key.
- `selector` (String) DKIM selector.
- `sign_dkim` (Boolean) Whether DKIM signing is enabled.
- `validated` (Boolean) Whether the definition is validated.
